formula_checks.name: allocatableThisMonth
formula_checks.why: Surplus less dated allocations, floored at zero for the allocation capacity; this is distinct from a negative surplus itself.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: nonMonthlyBasis
formula_checks.why: Percent-basis label applies only if every positive nonmonthly category is a percentage; rounding here is display metadata.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: monthlyEssentials
formula_checks.why: The algorithm intentionally estimates essentials from recurring categories, but no-category fallback includes all planned spending and ignores the needs distinction. Debts and continuing rent require the higher-level emergency-fund contract.
formula_checks.should_be: Label fallback as planned spend, preserve known zero essentials, and ensure debts/rent are added once at the emergency-fund door.

formula_checks.name: emergencyTest
formula_checks.why: Returns 0 months when essentials is zero and replaces a supplied zero essentials with another estimate. Neither is a valid cash ÷ zero result.
formula_checks.should_be: Preserve a confirmed zero denominator; show no finite burn rate/not applicable, or refuse if essentials is unknown.

formula_checks.name: savingsByMonth
formula_checks.why: Correct take-home minus planned expenses for the same month; monthly debt inclusion must be explicit at the calling door, rather than assumed inside spendByMonth.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: annualCashflow
formula_checks.why: Yearly identities reconcile when all inputs use the same twelve months and complete income/spending scope.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: budgetFromOnboarding
formula_checks.why: Storing an annual-average expense total alongside the same dated categories risks adding the annual bill again on reread. The persisted field meanings are not established.
formula_checks.should_be: Store recurring monthly base separately from annual-average display; retain category timing and prove a round trip.

formula_checks.name: budgetVsActual
formula_checks.why: Uses average spendBuckets as the selected month’s budget, which understates dated bill months and overstates other months.
formula_checks.should_be: Use spendByMonthByBucket for the requested month, the same producer used by This month and Expenses.

formula_checks.name: publishSurplus
formula_checks.why: Thin storage/event seam: passes the domain result unchanged or returns no stored result. Storage correctness cannot be inferred without implementation evidence.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: ym
formula_checks.why: Uses the person’s local calendar month; UTC date conversion must not change it. Cases include offset crossings.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: essentialsFromLoggedSpending
formula_checks.why: Averages the logged completed months only, labels sample count, and uses current month-to-date only when there is no earlier month. Partial-history coverage must accompany the estimate.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: essentialsMonthly
formula_checks.why: Uses the logged estimate before a positive typed fallback and otherwise refuses; sample basis is retained.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

rules_held.why: Dated budgetreaders honor own-month bills,but budgetVsActual still uses annual-average spendBuckets.
rules_held.decision_in_force: NOT A DECISION OF HIS — the lead's decision of 2026-10-23 under his rulings DEC-0002, DEC-0447 and DEC-0345, made without asking him, as his order of 2026-09-30 says. September with $700 of groceries and a $1,200 bill in December: This month −$700, the Expenses tab $700 (it read $800, with Once in a while $100), Home's September record $700. December: $1,900 on all three (Once in a while $1,200). A budget whose only line is the December bill reads $0 planned in September on both tabs — set, never "You haven't set your budget yet". A once-in-a-while bill with no month set is still a twelfth a month, as before. To reverse: build the Expenses tab's rows from the monthly average again. One word from him reverses it.

rules_held.why: Dated budgetreaders honor own-month bills,but budgetVsActual still uses annual-average spendBuckets.
rules_held.decision_in_force: NOT A DECISION OF HIS — the lead's decision of 2026-10-24 under his rulings DEC-0002, DEC-0447, DEC-4529 and DEC-3523 (tenet 1), made without asking him, as his order of 2026-09-30 says. His $2,000 a month typed ($1,100 bills & fixed, $900 everyday) with $1,200 of car insurance in December: every month read $1,900, the typed $2,000 taken to hold $100 a month of the bill, and the $1,100 / $900 split was dropped. Now eleven months read $2,000 and December $3,200. Where a figure is a whole year shown by the month it counts the bill once: MK-CF-F-002, the planned monthly figure, 2,000 + 1,200 ÷ 12 = $2,100 (it read $2,000); MK-CF-F-009, the must-pay figure, $2,000 (it read $1,900). The Net worth emergency fund in the family-inputs household: (2,900 × 12 + 3,600) ÷ 12 + 4,670 = $7,870 (it read $7,570), $31,489 ÷ 6,070 = 5.2 months (it read 5.5). On his approved Net worth v08 drawing's household, $4,500 a month typed and a $3,600 April premium: the months of essentials read 2.1 ($8,838 ÷ $4,150; the drawing shows 2.3, from $3,850), and at the planned spend 1.8 ($5,050; the drawing shows 1.9, from $4,750). The drawing is left as drawn, with the correction line his DEC-4529 asks for in its READ THIS FIRST and the matching allowed difference in its test. Sign-up's recap reads MK-CF-F-002. No ruling of his says a typed budget already holds such a bill. To reverse: read the typed total as holding a twelfth of each dated bill again. One word from him reverses it.
